### Solomon Prepares for the Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/solomon-prepares-for-the-temple
Passage: 1 Kings 5:18
Points:
- Solomon partnered with King Hiram of Tyre to obtain skilled craftsmen and materials to construct the temple.
- Tens of thousands of workers united to quarry foundation stones and shape timber according to God's plan.
- Conscripting Israelites into forced labor mirrored Samuel's warnings and foreshadowed future unrest in the kingdom.
- Believing God's faithful promises empowers His people to undertake arduous work in service to His kingdom.
